TASK:
Update L009 to operate in raw, not templated space

dbt - L009: Files must end with a single trailing newline.
<!--If this is a parsing or linting issue, please include a minimal SQL example which reproduces the issue, along with the `sqlfluff parse` output, `sqlfluff lint` output and `sqlfluff fix` output when relevant.-->

## Expected Behaviour
No error


## Observed Behaviour
```
L:  5 | P:  60 | L009 | Files must end with a single trailing newline.    
```

## Steps to Reproduce
A dbt model that calls a macro, eg:
```
{{ config ( materialized='incremental',
   transient=false,
    ) }}

{{ generate_table('mytable') }}

```

## Dialect
snowflake

## Version
sqlfluff, version 0.8.2
python 3.9

## Configuration
```
[tool.sqlfluff.core]
templater = "dbt"
sql_file_exts = ".sql,.sql.j2,.dml,.ddl"
dialect = "snowflake"
ignore_templated_areas = true

[tool.sqlfluff.indentation]
indented_joins = false
indented_using_on = true
template_blocks_indent = false

[tool.sqlfluff.templater.dbt]
project_dir = "."
profile = "snowflake"
```
